retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait of a seated figure in a formal suit against a window looking out into a dense, glowing starfield within a dark, wood-paneled room.
triggerTerms: man in suit sitting in dark room

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in a dark suit sits on a chair, head bowed, positioned in front of a large rectangular window that reveals a brilliant, dense field of stars and nebulae instead of a terrestrial view. The room is dark with rich wood paneling, and the entire image is covered in a heavy, distressed texture resembling a worn, folded vinyl record sleeve.
coreVisualRelationships: Figure centered against a luminous cosmic backdrop
Warm wood tones contrasting with cool starfield light
Heavy vertical and horizontal distressing over a dark composition
Formal attire juxtaposed with an infinite celestial environment
coreInvariants: The window must contain a dense starfield with visible lens flares
The room must feature dark, classical wood wainscoting
The overall image must have white scratch and fold textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, occupying the lower two-thirds of the vertical axis, scaled to appear grounded within the room.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, glowing starfield in the window serves as the primary light source and visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright window, moves down to the subject's bowed head, and follows the vertical lines of the suit and chair to the floor.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the corners and the dark wood paneling provide heavy negative space that compresses the central subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks from the wood and suit provide the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright gold, white, and cyan from the starfield provide high-value contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber highlights on the wood and the subject's skin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark, low-saturation room and the high-saturation, high-value cosmic window.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary colors outside the starfield
Maintain a dark, moody value range

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a white rectangular border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family sans-serif used in varying weights for informational clarity.
graphicDevices: Solid black background for text block

preserve: The rectangular framing of the text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for a warning label aesthetic.
Offers a clean, authoritative look that matches standard industry labeling.
Maintains the sturdy, blocky feel required for the corner metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, wood-paneled room with a central window showing a dense, glowing starfield. Place a man in a dark suit sitting on a chair in the center, looking down. Apply a heavy distressed paper texture with white scratches and fold marks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small white rectangular box in the bottom left corner. Inside the box, typeset metadata in a bold, condensed black sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the starfield the brightest element?
Is the figure centered and grounded?
Is the distressed texture visible across the entire frame?
Is the text block positioned in the bottom left corner?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing trademarked logos
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic wood grain texture
Ensure the starfield has varied star sizes and colors
Verify the distressing doesn't obscure the subject's face
Confirm the text box is perfectly rectangular
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Man in Suit] + Setting [Dark Wood Room] + Backdrop [Cosmic Window] + Overlay [Distressed Paper Texture] = Melancholic Surrealism
